ESPN Highlights. Ron Jans' last dance
programme.desc: In this extensive interview we speak to Ron Jans about his impressive career as a football coach. From the garden of his home in Tynaarlo, he looks back on the highlights and special moments at clubs such as FC Groningen, SC Heerenveen, PEC Zwolle, FC Twente and FC Utrecht. This is done using video messages from people with whom Jans has worked. From Erik Nevland to Frans van Seumeren, everyone has their say. – In this extensive interview we speak to Ron Jans about his impressive career as a football coach. He looks back on the highlights and special moments at clubs such as FC Groningen, sc Heerenveen, PEC Zwolle, FC Twente and FC Utrecht. NL. Sports, Football

programme.title: ESPN Film. FC Barcelona: dream, play, win
programme.desc: E5. Documentary about the FC Barcelona women's football team that broke free from an obscure existence and grew to become the top of the world. In three acts – Dream, Play and Win – star players Alèxia Putellas and Aitana Bonmatí, among others, talk about setbacks, identity and culture. On this road to success we see, among other things, the role that Lieke Martens played and how the team won the Champions League in Eindhoven in 2023. – Documentary about the FC Barcelona women's football team that broke free from an obscure existence and grew to become the top of the world. programme.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it was only belatedly realized in Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. programme.desc: episode. In the program, viewers will see fragments of memorable matches played in the UEFA Europa League. From the 2009/2010 season, this competition replaced the previous UEFA Cup. programme.title: I was a king – Kazimierz Kmiecik | S01E04
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Kazimierz Kmiecik is a legend of Wisła Kraków. He was associated with it both as a player and as a coach. To this day, he is the best scorer in the history of the White Star. He scored 153 goals in 304 matches played. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E02
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes, to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet... Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Javier Irureta» Jabo Irureta is, after the late Luis Aragonés, the coach with the most games coached in the First Division. From 1984 to 2017 he coached Logroñés, Oviedo, Racing, Athletic Club, Real Sociedad, Celta de Vigo, Deportivo de La Coruña, Betis and Zaragoza for a total of 612 matches played. Irureta achieved success as a player at Atlético de Madrid and Athletic Club and as a coach he entered the living history of Deportivo with the achievement of the League title in the 1999-2000 season and the Copa del Rey trophy in 2002, a match already known historically as the Centenariazo. He also won two Spanish Super Cups with the Galician team.

programme.title: 30 for 30: One and Not Done
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: д/с Kingdom of the Mummies (Пустой саркофаг)
programme.desc: In the recently discovered tomb complex at Saqqara, one burial chamber with an empty stone sarcophagus stands out, while all the other sarcophagi contain mummies. Malawi Wildlife Rescue: Tsiba's New Mum (S2E4). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep4 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Tackle an emergency when Dr. Amanda removes a sable antelope's tracking collar, and see the animal-care team help a flea-riddled baby vervet monkey find a new mom. Free two orphaned serval cats and follow 20 yellow baboons into their new enclosureMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith, Charlotte Bentley

programme.title: Battle Of the Alphas: Southeast Asia (S1E8). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2021. S1, Ep8
programme.desc: 2021 г. Год: 2021. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2021. S1, Ep8 «Battle of the Alphas»…With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill – on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriorsFrom turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head with their own kind, in Battle of the AlphasDirector: Karen McCairleyCast: Mark Clermont

programme.title: Animals Like Us: Shark Dentist (S1E6) (Bizim Gibi Davranan Hayvanlar). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. programme.title: After the Wildfires. Dokumentika. Australija, 2020
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Australija. programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests: Mountains (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2023. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep4 «Secrets of the Enchanted Forests»…Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit trystTraverse the planet's richest and most diverse woodlands – from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between – and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless speciesDirector: Laura Coates, Mark ThorpCast: Fenella Fudge

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Giant Otter Refuge (S1E9). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep9
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep9 «Brazil Untamed»…At the southern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the world's largest tropical wetlands, Biologist Carolina Ribas and her local guide, Arilei Terena search for a giant otter den. Despite their large size, noisy and gregarious nature, endangered giant otters are notoriously shy and hard to findThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Leopards in Mumbai, hyenas in Harar, peregrine falcons in New York, flocks of starlings in Rome: The final part of the “Terra X” series about extreme habitats shows how wild animals have adapted to cities. The cheekiest inhabitants are probably rhesus monkeys, which dominate entire neighborhoods in Jaipur.

programme.title: Blue Wonder Pacific
programme.desc:
At 166 million square kilometers, the Pacific Ocean is larger than all of our planet's land areas combined. And it encompasses habitats that could hardly be more contrasting: the fantastic gardens of tropical coral reefs, the endless water desert of the open sea, the dense kelp forests off the coast of America. 

In two parts, “Terra X” portrays inhabitants of these worlds – the blue whale, for example. The probably largest animal that has ever lived in the world feeds on tiny creatures: it scoops up to forty million small crustaceans out of the water every day with its baleen. The sea otters off Big Sur are also food specialists. They specialize in sea urchins and prevent the spiny creatures from eating the seabed bare. 

Meanwhile, a heartbreaking drama is unfolding on the beaches of Costa Rica: When the olive ridley sea turtles hatch in September, hungry birds of prey and dogs are already waiting...

programme.desc: Được huấn luyện bởi SAS của Anh, họ được thành lập vào năm 1969 để chống lại lực lượng Cộng sản đang trỗi dậy. Khám phá chủ nghĩa anh hùng và sự hy sinh của các đặc công tinh nhuệ của Malaysia.

programme.title: PAWN STARS S24 EP614
programme.desc: Khi Rick câu được một chiếc phao câu cá bằng thủy tinh cổ được sản xuất tại Nhật Bản, anh ấy hy vọng giá của người bán sẽ làm thuyền của anh ấy trôi nổi. Trong khi đó, Chum kiểm tra hóa thạch khủng long quý hiếm. Anh ta có thể đào được một mức giá tốt?

programme.title: THE SECRET OF SKINWALKER RANCH S5 EP10
programme.desc: Sau khi nghe lời khai đáng kinh ngạc về một UFO rơi xuống Trang trại Skinwalker nhiều năm trước, nhóm nghiên cứu đã có một khám phá gây sốc bên trong Mesa đầy đá.

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP19
programme.desc: Một kẻ yếu thế phá vỡ khuôn mẫu bằng cách tạo ra tính năng chụp ảnh tức thì, cách mạng hóa cách chúng ta chụp ảnh. Và nó khởi đầu một cuộc chiến đổi mới giữa hai công ty đang tranh giành vị trí thương hiệu máy ảnh số một.

programme.title: CỖ MÁY CHIẾN ĐẤU - THE FIGHT MACHINE
programme.desc: Hai chàng trai trẻ người Canada đến từ những thế giới hoàn toàn khác nhau đang bị mắc kẹt trong một cuộc sống ngoài tầm kiểm soát của anh. Khi họ bị kéo vào vòng chiến đấu tay không không thể tha thứ dưới lòng đất, sự va chạm của họ đã khơi dậy một hành trình báo thù, trả thù và khám phá bản thân tàn khốc.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM THÉP - IRON KUNG FU FIST
programme.desc: Liang Kun là một cao thủ võ thuật điêu luyện, rời bỏ giới võ lâm để bảo vệ người yêu. Tuy nhiên, sự biến mất của anh đã dẫn đến cái chết bi thảm của cô và khi Liang Kun tìm cách sống sót trong thế giới võ thuật, anh đã chiến đấu trở lại để trả thù cho cái chết của người yêu với sự giúp đỡ của một thủ lĩnh băng đảng ăn xin.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: KẺ ĐÀO TẨU - NIGHT WALK
programme.desc: Frank bị buộc tội giết người sau khi bạn gái của anh bị giết trong một vụ việc bi thảm trong chuyến thăm Trung Đông của họ. Anh ta bị đưa đến một nhà tù, nơi anh ta gặp một tù nhân Hồi giáo, người đã giúp anh ta lên kế hoạch vượt ngục để chứng minh mình vô tội. Khi người bạn đột ngột qua đời, liệu Frank có thể trốn thoát thành công và tìm lại công lý cho mình?
